story_title: Lina and Adams and the Dress-Up Show
title: Lina and Adams and the Dress-Up Show 🎩 | Learn Clothes Words in English for Kids | Moon Tales Kids
description:
Grandma is coming! Lina, Adams and Milo the cat put on a funny dress-up show with a big box of clothes. 🎩👟🧦
In this English story for kids, children learn 7 new words: hat, shoes, socks, shirt, jacket, button and pocket. Listen, repeat, and learn English with Lina, Adams and Milo the cat.

📚 New words in this story:
🎩 hat — قبعة / طاقية — le chapeau
👟 shoes — حذاء / صباط — les chaussures
🧦 socks — جوارب / تقاشر — les chaussettes
👕 shirt — قميص — la chemise / le t-shirt
🧥 jacket — سترة / جاكيط — la veste
🔘 button — زر / بوطونة — le bouton
👖 pocket — جيب — la poche

👨‍👩‍👧 For parents: when your child gets dressed, name each piece of clothing in English together: "Where are your socks?" Pause after each new word and say it out loud. Perfect for ages 3 to 8 and for children learning English as a second language.

lines.text: It is the evening. The sky is orange and pink.
Lina and Adams are playing in the bedroom with Milo the cat.
Adams! Grandma is coming to visit tonight!
Let's make a show for Grandma. A dress-up show!
Lina opens a big box. It is full of clothes.
Look at all these clothes! This will be so much fun.
Meow! Meow!
Lina finds something round and soft in the box.
A hat! A big blue hat!
Lina puts the hat on her head. It is very big!
I cannot see your eyes, Lina! Ha ha!
A hat is something we wear on our head.
Say it with me: hat!
Milo jumps into the hat. Now Milo is in the hat! Meow!
Adams finds two big brown shoes. They are Daddy's shoes.
Look at me! I have big shoes!
Adams walks. Clop, clop, clop!
Your shoes are so big. Be careful, Adams!
Shoes are what we wear on our feet when we walk outside.
Can you say it? Shoes!
These shoes are too big. I will walk slowly.
Next, Lina finds some soft socks with yellow dots.
Socks! We wear socks inside our shoes.
Socks keep our feet warm and cosy.
Say it with me: socks!
Oh no! I have only one sock. Where is the other sock?
Don't worry, Lina. We will find it together!
Adams takes out a shirt with green stripes.
I will wear this shirt for the show.
Adams puts his arms in the shirt. But it is upside down! Ha ha!
Let me help you, Adams. Arms in here, head in here.
Thank you, Lina! Now my shirt is right.
A shirt is clothes we wear on our body and arms.
Let's say it together: shirt!
At the bottom of the box, there is a yellow jacket.
I love this jacket! It is yellow like the sun.
Lina puts on the jacket. It is soft and warm.
A jacket is something we wear over our clothes, when it is cool outside.
Can you say it? Jacket!
Meow!
Milo likes your jacket, Lina!
The jacket has three round buttons.
Oh! This button is very hard. I cannot close it.
I can help! Let's do it together.
Lina holds the jacket, and Adams pushes the button. Pop!
A button is a small round thing that closes our clothes.
Say it with me: button!
We did it! Teamwork!
Lina puts her hand in the jacket pocket.
Wait! There is something soft in my pocket.
Lina pulls it out. It is the other sock!
You found your sock! But how did it get there?
Meow!
Milo the cat hid the sock in the pocket! Silly Milo!
A pocket is a little bag in our clothes. Say it with me: pocket!
Ding dong! Grandma is here!
Lina and Adams go out to the garden for the show.
Welcome, Grandma! It is our dress-up show!
Lina walks in her yellow jacket, her blue hat and her dotty socks.
Adams walks in his green shirt and Daddy's big shoes. Clop, clop!
Grandma claps and claps. Hooray!
Thank you for watching, Grandma!
And now, the last star of the show is... Milo!
Milo walks in, wearing a tiny little hat.
Meow! Meow!
Everybody laughs. Milo is so funny!
Milo is the best dancer in the show!
Grandma gives Milo a gentle pat on the head.
We made a great show together.
Now the sky is dark. The stars are shining.
Grandma gives Lina and Adams a big warm hug.
Thank you for coming, Grandma. We love you!
Did you like our show?
Grandma smiles. She liked it very, very much.
Lina and Adams are happy. They made Grandma smile.
Purr, purr.
It is bedtime now.
Lina and Adams fold the clothes and put them back in the box.
The hat, the shoes, the socks, the shirt and the jacket.
And no more socks in the pocket, Milo!
Milo curls up on the bed and closes his eyes.
Goodnight, Lina. Goodnight, Milo.
Goodnight! Let's make another show tomorrow!
